correctness.rationale: Averaging the weak-barrier projection inequalities over all diagonal sign vectors gives an integral deficit for the Rademacher absolute first moment. The exact second and fourth Rademacher moments imply a pointwise lower bound by one minus the fourth-power coordinate sum, up to the stated dimensional factor. On the off-axis set, convex maximization of the squared coordinate masses gives a uniform gap of twice sin²(beta)cos²(beta). Integration yields the claimed linear estimate. The bundled checker verifies the moment identities and pointwise inequalities on finite grids, while the proof is fully analytic.
